extracted_information: The provided web content details Botpress's usage-based pricing model, including various plans, add-ons, and AI spending details. Information about specific open-source features of the Botpress product itself is not available, though a 'Botpress for Good' program for open-source projects is mentioned.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.description: Ideal for hobbyists, solo developers, or those exploring AI chatbots. Designed for building and experimenting without initial cost.

plans.name: Plus
included_features: One of each add-on (Incoming Messages & Events, Table Rows, Bots, Always Alive, Collaborator, Vector DB Storage, File Storage)
Room for an additional bot with a collaborator

plans.name: Team
plans.description: For teams aiming to enhance chatbot building, or builders spending above $495 on limits in Pay-as-you-go.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.description: For organizations requiring robust solutions with advanced features, top-tier security, and premium support.

add_ons.name: Incoming Messages & Events
add_ons.definition: Any action that triggers bot activation. Only messages/events a bot listens to count.

add_ons.name: Always Alive
add_ons.cost: $10/month for each additional Always Alive enhancement
add_ons.definition: Reserves compute for faster initial responses.

add_ons.name: Collaborator
add_ons.definition: A member seat on your Workspace.

add_ons.name: Vector DB Storage
add_ons.cost: $20/month for each additional 1GB of Vector DB Storage
add_ons.definition: For knowledge your Bot uses to answer questions (e.g., Tables searchable, Documents, Text Documents, Websites as KB source).

add_ons.name: File Storage
add_ons.cost: $10/month for each additional 10 GB of File Storage
add_ons.definition: For images, audio, and video your Bot sends or receives.

ai_spend.description: Budget allocated for bot's usage of LLMs, charged at provider cost without markup.
ai_spend.billing_mechanism: LLM usage billed directly at the provider's price. All AI Spend exceeding $5/month charged to credit card.
features: Cost Dashboard (track token usage and spending live)

references.name: OpenAI Pricing Page
references.context: For GPT 3.5 Turbo and GPT 4 model pricing, as Botpress does not mark-up AI token costs.

free_tier_limitations.pay_as_you_go_plan_entry: Designed to build and experiment without any initial cost.
free_tier_limitations.ai_spend_credit: $5 USD monthly credit for AI tokens.
free_tier_limitations.message_event_limit_action: After workspace reaches incoming messages & events limit, all bots will stop responding.
free_tier_limitations.ai_spend_limit_action: After $5 monthly AI Spend credit is consumed, user must increase AI Spend limit or wait for next monthly period for AI Spend credits to reset.
free_tier_limitations.limit_reset_option: Wait until the first of the next month for message usage/AI spend to reset, or purchase a limit increase.
